title: Development Tribunal decision 19-028: large isolated office and workshop building; fire engineering report amended for smoke ventilation and sprinkler removal (Pittsworth)
jurisdiction: Queensland, Australia. COMPARATIVE TEST ONLY: not Alberta; no Alberta applicability asserted.
code_edition: BCA 2015 as cited (Table E1.5, p. 2; Part E Table E2.2a, p. 3); other citations not stated
document_type: Development Tribunal decision notice (Planning Act 2016 s 255), Queensland
document_date: Decision notice dated 21 Oct 2019 (PDF p. 7); hearing 15 Aug 2019 (p. 1)

facts.text: Queensland Fire and Emergency Services (appellant) appealed a Building Act 1975 development decision notice for a building at a Pittsworth site; the assessment manager was a building certifier.
The notice describes the subject building as a large isolated building with floor area 14,150 m2 and volume greater than 108,000 m3.
facts.locator: p. 6, reasons para 1; p. 3 ('Large Isolated Building')

facts.text: The works are described as Class 5 (office, boardroom and staff room) and Class 8 (workshop and mezzanine); the notice also lists Class 7b (p. 3).
The development relied on Omnii Consulting Fire Engineers report, Project 7305100 Rev B, which the notice says proposed removing some sprinklers and natural smoke venting.

The tribunal set the decision aside and replaced it with approval subject to amending the fire engineering report to include smoke-ventilation modelling referencing as-constructed readily openable vents, and a qualitative approach under s 1.2.9.2 of the International Fire Engineering Guidelines.
The notice cites Table E1.5 of the BCA 2015 (deemed-to-satisfy smoke exhaust and sprinkler systems) and BCA Part E Table E2.2a for large isolated buildings.
